summary: Per spatial cell, contract the atomic four-family assembled SIG collision matrices (CX, H-H2, H-P, H-H) with the Fortran-order flattened predecessor distributions to four (nvr,nvx,nx) Alpha collision-frequency fields.

identity.relation: Alpha_CX[:,:,k] = F^-1(SIG_CX @ F(fi_hat[:,:,k]*ni[k])), Alpha_H_H2[:,:,k] = F^-1(SIG_H_H2 @ F(fH2[:,:,k])), Alpha_H_P[:,:,k] = F^-1(SIG_H_P @ F(fi_hat[:,:,k]*ni[k])), Alpha_H_H[:,:,k] = F^-1(SIG_H_H @ F(fH[:,:,k])), where F/F^-1 are the source's legacy Fortran-order (order='F') flatten/restore between the (nvr,nvx) slice and the (nvr*nvx,) Work carrier.
identity.direction: four assembled SIG collision matrices + explicit predecessor distributions (fi_hat, ni, fH2, fH) -> four Alpha collision-frequency fields (Alpha_CX, Alpha_H_H2, Alpha_H_P, Alpha_H_H)
identity.definition: The saved source's per-k matrix-vector contraction: each family multiplies one assembled (N,N) SIG matrix by the Fortran-order flattening of one predecessor distribution carried on the (nvr*nvx,) Work buffer and restores the product to the (nvr,nvx) slice. The CX and H-P families carry fi_hat scaled cell-wise by ni[k]; the H-H2 and H-H families carry the bare predecessor distributions fH2 and fH.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim and reproduced bit for bit on the declared legal domain (SHA-256-pinned environment-gated replay)
identity.geometry: per spatial cell k: an (nvr,nvx) cylindrical velocity slice Fortran-order flattened to an (N,) carrier (N = nvr*nvx), contracted against an (N,N) assembled collision matrix, restored to (nvr,nvx); iterated over nx slices
identity.coordinates: cylindrical (vr,vx) velocity space per spatial slice x; velocity axes in the caller's normalized units, densities in m^-3; the callable performs no implicit unit conversion
identity.boundary: finite aligned inputs of the declared shapes; negative or zero densities are not rejected at runtime -- every finite density profile is contracted as given; bounded negative output cells inherited from the signed elastic SIG families (vx_vx / vr2_vx2 factors) are reproduced as-is, never clamped
assumptions: The saved formal operator is ported verbatim; no repair is claimed for the atomic arm.

The SIG matrices arrive already assembled (atomic four-family collision-matrix assembly): entries are cross section times relative speed times the velocity-space quadrature weight evaluated on the (vr,vx) energy carrier, including the signed elastic vx_vx / vr2_vx2 factors; this operator only contracts and never clamps or re-scales them.
Bounded negative cells inherited from the signed elastic SIG families are reproduced as-is; whether they correspond to physically acceptable diffusion behavior is left to expert review.
Negative or zero densities are not rejected at runtime; the saved domain assumes physically meaningful finite profiles, and the fail-closed contract covers only shape/alignment and non-finite values.
No external atomic-physics reference is bound: the saved package records that residual as validation_oracle_gap.

inputs.name: SIG_CX
inputs.description: Assembled H + H+ charge-exchange collision matrix from the atomic four-family assembly: sigma_cx evaluated on the velocity-carrier energy grid, multiplied by the relative speed and the (Vr2pidVr*dVx) quadrature weight, laid out on the Fortran-order flattened (nvr*nvx) velocity carrier.
inputs.units: source-discrete assembled collision-matrix measure (cross section x relative speed x velocity-space weight); no implicit conversion
inputs.constraints: Finite; must be 2-D square with order exactly nvr*nvx. The saved assembly produces a nonnegative SIG_CX; the contraction preserves whatever sign pattern the caller supplies.

inputs.name: SIG_H_H
inputs.description: Assembled H-H elastic (viscosity-branch) collision matrix: sigma_el_h_h with the mu energy factor and the source's /8 constant, weight Vr2pidVr*dVx, on the same Fortran-order velocity carrier.
inputs.units: source-discrete assembled collision-matrix measure (cross section x relative speed x velocity-space weight); no implicit conversion
inputs.constraints: Finite; 2-D square with order exactly nvr*nvx. Contains bounded negative cells from the signed elastic factors; reproduced as-is.

inputs.name: SIG_H_H2
inputs.description: Assembled H-H2 elastic collision matrix: sigma_el_h_hh with weight Vr2pidVr*dVx times the signed vx_vx factor, on the same Fortran-order velocity carrier.
inputs.units: source-discrete assembled collision-matrix measure (cross section x relative speed x velocity-space weight); no implicit conversion
inputs.constraints: Finite; 2-D square with order exactly nvr*nvx. Contains bounded negative cells from the signed vx_vx factor; reproduced as-is.

inputs.name: SIG_H_P
inputs.description: Assembled H-H+ elastic collision matrix: sigma_el_p_h (two energy branches) with weight Vr2pidVr*dVx times the signed vx_vx factor, on the same Fortran-order velocity carrier.
inputs.units: source-discrete assembled collision-matrix measure (cross section x relative speed x velocity-space weight); no implicit conversion
inputs.constraints: Finite; 2-D square with order exactly nvr*nvx. Contains bounded negative cells from the signed vx_vx factor; reproduced as-is.

inputs.name: fi_hat
inputs.description: Atomic neutral Maxwellian seed distribution on the cylindrical (vr,vx) velocity mesh, one (nvr,nvx) slice per spatial cell; scaled cell-wise by ni[k] inside the Alpha_CX and Alpha_H_P contractions.
inputs.constraints: Finite; shape (nvr,nvx,nx) exactly; its leading axes define N = nvr*nvx for every SIG matrix.

inputs.name: ni
inputs.description: Ion density profile scaling the fi_hat carrier in the Alpha_CX and Alpha_H_P contractions (one value per spatial cell).
inputs.constraints: Finite; 1-D with size nx. Negative or zero entries are not rejected at runtime: the contraction uses each value as given.

inputs.name: fH2
inputs.description: Molecular neutral velocity distribution on the cylindrical (vr,vx) mesh, the predecessor carried unchanged into the Alpha_H_H2 contraction.

inputs.name: fH
inputs.description: Atomic neutral velocity distribution on the cylindrical (vr,vx) mesh, the predecessor carried unchanged into the Alpha_H_H contraction.

outputs.name: Alpha_CX
outputs.description: H + H+ charge-exchange collision-frequency field: SIG_CX contracted with the Fortran-order flattened (fi_hat*ni) carrier, one (nvr,nvx) slice per spatial cell.
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled SIG measure; no implicit conversion)
outputs.constraints: Finite (fail closed otherwise); nonnegative on the saved domain where SIG_CX is nonnegative; never clamped.

outputs.name: Alpha_H_H2
outputs.description: H-H2 elastic collision-frequency field: SIG_H_H2 contracted with the Fortran-order flattened fH2 slice.
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled SIG measure; no implicit conversion)
outputs.constraints: Finite (fail closed otherwise); bounded negative cells inherited from the signed vx_vx SIG factor are reproduced as-is, never clamped.

outputs.name: Alpha_H_P
outputs.description: H-H+ elastic collision-frequency field: SIG_H_P contracted with the Fortran-order flattened (fi_hat*ni) carrier.
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled SIG measure; no implicit conversion)
outputs.constraints: Finite (fail closed otherwise); bounded negative cells inherited from the signed vx_vx SIG factor are reproduced as-is, never clamped.

outputs.name: Alpha_H_H
outputs.description: H-H elastic collision-frequency field: SIG_H_H contracted with the Fortran-order flattened fH slice.
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled SIG measure; no implicit conversion)
outputs.constraints: Finite (fail closed otherwise); bounded negative cells inherited from the signed vx_vx / vr2_vx2 SIG factors are reproduced as-is, never clamped.

preconditions: Finite aligned SIG matrices of common order nvr*nvx and finite (nvr,nvx,nx) distributions with an (nx,) density profile.
The predecessor distributions and the assembled SIG matrices already exist; this operator performs no assembly, gating, or cache handling.
supported: Atomic four-family Alpha collision-frequency contraction (Alpha_CX, Alpha_H_H2, Alpha_H_P, Alpha_H_H) on a declared velocity carrier.
excluded: Molecular three-family contraction, the Omega_* downstream aggregation inside do_fH_Iterate, Do_Alpha_* gating, KH.Internal cache lifecycle, and external physical validation.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when a SIG matrix is not 2-D square, when any SIG order differs from the nvr*nvx carrier, when any distribution is not (nvr,nvx,nx), when ni is not 1-D of size nx, or when any input contains a non-finite value.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if any contracted family produces a non-finite array; no partial results are returned.

python.signature: contract_atomic_hydrogen_alpha_frequencies(SIG_CX, SIG_H_H, SIG_H_H2, SIG_H_P, fi_hat, ni, fH2, fH)

example.description: With identity SIG matrices each Alpha family equals its carrier scaled by the matching density; a misordered SIG matrix is rejected.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import contract_atomic_hydrogen_alpha_frequencies
nvr, nvx, nx = 2, 3, 2
N = nvr * nvx
fi_hat = np.ones((nvr, nvx, nx))
result = contract_atomic_hydrogen_alpha_frequencies(
    np.eye(N), np.eye(N), np.eye(N), np.eye(N), fi_hat,
    np.full(nx, 1e18), fi_hat, fi_hat,
)
assert set(result) == {"Alpha_CX", "Alpha_H_H2", "Alpha_H_P", "Alpha_H_H"}
np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["Alpha_CX"], fi_hat * 1e18)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["Alpha_H_H2"], fi_hat)
try:
    contract_atomic_hydrogen_alpha_frequencies(
        np.eye(2), np.eye(N), np.eye(N), np.eye(N), fi_hat,
        np.full(nx, 1e18), fi_hat, fi_hat,
    )
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError("a SIG order differing from the velocity carrier must be rejected")
example.expected: Observed PASS: Alpha_CX equals fi_hat scaled by ni, Alpha_H_H2 equals the bare fH2 carrier, and the misordered SIG arm raises ValueError.
